_comment: LoomLab rate card: the prices quotes are made from. Money in rupees. screen_cost per screen; ink_per_kg for any ink not in ink_prices (keys: ink name as on the plate, or its hex); ink_g_per_sqm = grams of ink per square metre printed at full cover; fabric_per_meter 0 = client supplies cloth; labour_per_meter_per_screen = printing labour, every screen passes every meter. Edit and save: the next quote uses it. manual_minutes_per_design / review_minutes_per_design / staff_cost_per_hour are only for the Jobs page's time-saved estimate.
